title: Dashboard, account and marketing pages, animated charts, building blocks and 90 more icons

entries.text: New blocks for common pages: analytics dashboard, ecommerce dashboard, project overview, user management, profile, billing, API keys, invoice, checkout, landing page, inbox, top-nav layout and a 404 page.
Page building parts: theme toggle, user menu, settings layout, description list, bar list, comparison table, invoice and landing sections (hero, feature grid, stats, FAQ, CTA banner, footer).

Animated charts: area chart (stacked or overlapping), scatter and bubble chart, matrix heatmap, stacked bar chart, radial bar chart and a live streaming chart. Sparkline, bar chart, donut and line chart now play an entrance (wipe, grow or sweep) when scrolled into view, and skip it for reduced motion.
About 90 new icons: arrows, finance, files, devices, status, layout, people and editor tools.
AI docs: llms.txt now has a page-recipe section (which blocks and parts to combine for a dashboard, settings page, landing page and more) and a block index grouped by purpose.

Stat card: the delta line no longer wraps word by word and the sparkline no longer spills out of a narrow card; it drops below the number instead. Donut chart: the legend wraps under the ring in narrow cards.

title: Pivot and tree tables, week view, uploads with progress and auth blocks

entries.text: Pivot table: cross-tab of your rows with sum, count, average, min or max, totals and heat shading.
Tree table: rows with child rows, opened by click or arrow keys.
File uploader: several files at once with a progress bar each, cancel, retry and a concurrency limit.
Onboarding carousel: swipeable mobile intro with dots, Skip and a final Get started button.
Auth blocks: sign up with a password strength meter, and a four-step reset password flow.
Week view: the event calendar now switches between month and week, and the week lists every event.
Event calendar: a multi-day event now names itself once, on its first day and at the start of each week row, instead of on every day.
Changelog: every older release is rewritten with a bold label on each note, so it reads like the newer ones.
Version log: each release groups its notes under Added, Changed, Fixed and Removed, with a bold lead phrase on every note so a long release can be skimmed. Larger text and clearer spacing.
Event calendar: the "+n more" label no longer reads backwards in right-to-left pages.

title: Install flow, four new components, two blocks and locale support

entries.text: New components: phone input (country picker, E.164 output), signature pad, event calendar (month view, multi-day events) and virtual list for huge datasets.
New blocks: pricing page and settings page.
Install flow: every component page now shows the befui add command first, and has a Copy for AI button that copies the install line, an example and the full source.
RTL switch: every preview can be flipped right-to-left to check a component.

Locale support: calendar, date picker and range picker take a locale for month and weekday names and digits. Calendar flips its arrows and arrow-key movement in right-to-left pages, and the currency input and date picker use logical start and end spacing.

title: Animated changelog and a version log component

entries.text: Version log: an animated version history component. The rail draws and dots pop as releases scroll in, entries slide in one by one, releases fold open, with a version jump strip and a kind filter. The changelog page uses it.
Changelog page: a page on the docs site where you can click any component name to open it. Click any component name to open it.
Icons: 95 new ones (189 in total), covering devices and media, commerce, charts, text formatting, files, map and travel, status, playback and more. Find them on the Icons page.

title: Sixty new components, blocks and a smarter CLI

entries.text: Page furniture: changelog, testimonial card, comment thread, code block, status dot, table of contents.
Search and input helpers: search bar with live results, currency input, inline edit, filter bar, notification center, cookie consent.
Roles and access: permission matrix with per-column toggles and locked roles.
Tooltip: gets a title, keyboard shortcut, light style and arrow, plus InfoTip and TruncatedText.
Data table: row selection with bulk actions, a column menu, sticky header, toolbar slot, row action menus and clickable rows. Table gets a footer and caption.
Boards, feeds and menus: kanban, activity feed, context menu.
Loader: six animations, a bar and an overlay.
Date range picker: gets quick presets (Last 7 days, This month and more) and a day count.
Reports table block: search, filters, sorting, row actions and a details drawer.
Online shop: product card, coupon input, order summary.
Layout and lists: split pane, sortable list, navbar, bottom navigation, floating action button.
People and conversation: chat, mention input, profile card, terminal, error state, image viewer.
Charts and files: line chart, radar chart, audit log, file manager.
Mobile and uploads: swipe actions, pull to refresh, bottom sheet, date and time picker, image upload.
Avatar: gets presence dots, square shape, an extra-large size, hover names on groups and UserInfo.
Avatar upload: pick a photo and see it instantly.
Forms and settings: schema form (multi-step wizard), rich text editor, notification preferences, saved views.
Planning and flow: funnel chart, gantt chart, org chart, approval flow, onboarding checklist, tag manager.
Shortcuts dialog: press ? to open it. Also number formatting helpers.
Sales dashboard block: KPI cards, revenue line chart, funnel and top deals.
CLI: the update command adds missing animations to your index.css; befui add warns when one is missing. befui mcp runs an MCP server for AI tools.
Icons everywhere: every component now uses the built-in icon set. lucide-react is no longer installed by init.
Docs site: loads demos on demand (main bundle 1.4 MB down to 0.58 MB), and llms.txt is grouped by category with rules and a task map.
Time: time picker, analog clock, world clock, stopwatch, timer, countdown and relative time.
Data and display: heatmap and pricing card.
AI tooling: llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AGENTS.md rules written by init, a Use with AI page, and befui add all.

Inputs and forms: button, input, label and field, checkbox, switch, select, combobox, calendar, date picker, segmented, slider, radio group, rating, OTP input, tag input, number stepper, chip, color picker.
Display and motion: accordion, spotlight card, border beam, marquee, carousel, compare, tilt card, shimmer text, typewriter, confetti, dock, collapsible, tree view.
Data and layout: data table, gauge, progress ring, number ticker, stat card, charts, sidebar, app shell.
Feedback and overlays: banner, alert, toast, skeleton, dialog and sheet, alert dialog, dropdown menu, popover, tooltip, command palette.
Foundations: a built-in icon set, Storybook, the befui CLI (init, add, list), and HRMS and marketing blocks.
